# Anviq

Anviq is an independent IT consulting and software practice based in Europe. One engineer owns delivery from the first conversation through handover.

Anviq works across custom software and automation, integration with existing systems, Service as a Software, forward-deployed engineering, and infrastructure where hosting, access, and data handling are agreed with the client.

Selected work:
- https://anviq.net/projects/agents — Persistent AI teammates and isolated execution infrastructure.
- https://anviq.net/projects/steadyward — Read-only behavioural retention infrastructure for MT4/MT5 brokers.
- https://anviq.net/projects/lv-matching — Multi-tenant construction bill-of-quantities matching.
- https://anviq.net/projects/addreach — German-market outbound sending infrastructure.
- https://anviq.net/projects/recruitment-crm — Deterministic recruitment workflow software.

Start with a conversation or a scoped technical assessment:
https://anviq.net/explore/engagement
